description: This Java source file defines the VariableIntallmentsTransactionHelper class used for interacting with loan schedules and variations via REST API calls in the Fineract project. It includes methods for retrieving loan schedules, validating variation calculations, and submitting variations, with all network interactions handled through utility methods.

classes.name: VariableIntallmentsTransactionHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing loan schedule interactions related to variable installments, including retrieval, validation, and submission of schedule variations.

methods.name: VariableIntallmentsTransactionHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the request and response specifications for API interactions.

methods.name: retrieveSchedule
methods.description: Retrieves the repayment schedule for a given loan ID from the server.

methods.name: validateVariations
methods.description: Validates loan schedule variations by sending a calculation request to the server.

methods.name: submitVariations
methods.description: Submits variations to the loan schedule on the server.
